about: The introitus of the formulary “22nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: If You, O Lord, mark iniquities, Lord, who can stand? But with You is forgiveness, O God of Israel. Out of the depths I cry to You, O Lord; Lord, hear my voice! Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. If You, O Lord, mark iniquities, Lord, who can stand? But with You is forgiveness, O God of Israel.
